project.name: Equipment Lending Desk
project.summary: Own camera reservation policy, explicit confirmation, cancellation, durable operation identity and retry ownership.

evidence.summary: Own camera reservation policy, explicit confirmation, cancellation, durable operation identity and retry ownership.
A local operator reserves and confirms cameras.
Core owns decisions; adapters own technical effects. Bootstrap does not implement product code.
RM01 is the complete reservation journey; RM02 reporting remains future.

facts.statement: Use .NET 10 and React with the managed exact toolchains.
The public HTTP and browser fixture contracts fix observable V1 behavior and durable identity.

included.statement: Own camera reservation policy, explicit confirmation, cancellation, durable operation identity and retry ownership.
Use Foundation JSON/HTTP defaults and immutable Forms 0.2 production/admission/React rendering.

excluded.statement: No production deployment, payment or identity-provider integration in this disposable local fixture.

deferred.statement: RM02 reporting stays planned and unmaterialized.

actors.statement: An operator reserves, confirms and cancels a camera.

journeys.statement: One valid reservation outcome with no duplicate or denied effects.

quality_requirements.statement: Denied policies and illegal transitions produce no stock or notification effects.
Idempotent replay preserves operation/reservation identity; conflicting reuse is rejected.
Accepted reservations and pending notification ownership survive process restart.
Required confirmation is acknowledged before reporting success.

integrations.statement: Immutable Forms are published through public build-time APIs and rendered through supported React APIs.
Persistence is behind an explicit replaceable Core port; durable notification retry has an owner.

choices.decision: One Lending bounded context owns a reservation module with proportional Core logic and explicit persistence/effect ports.
choices.rationale: The state, language, ownership and consistency boundary coincide; adapters can vary without changing policy.

choices.decision: Use build-time immutable Forms release production and supported React rendering; do not deploy management.
choices.rationale: The fixture consumes fixed published form contracts.

founding_decision_candidates.title: Keep one lending consistency boundary with explicit adapter ports
founding_decision_candidates.question: Which model owns reservation decisions, state transitions and durable handover?
founding_decision_candidates.recommended_option: One Lending bounded context owns a reservation module with proportional Core logic and explicit persistence/effect ports.
alternatives: Separate each HTTP action into an unrelated context.
Couple policy, HTTP and storage in one implementation.
founding_decision_candidates.rationale: The state, language, ownership and consistency boundary coincide; adapters can vary without changing policy.
consequences: The feature proves policy ordering, state transitions, runtime resolution and adapter replacement.
Immutable Forms are produced during build and admitted/rendered through public released APIs.
Architecture creates a Proposed founding ADR and closes actual early compatibility risks before review.
